node.statement: The cb triangle inequality and lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness now give ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb <= 3*d+D*eta = (3*C_T+4*D)*eta. Since C_T,D >= 0, 3*C_T+4*D <= 6*C_T+7*D=C_Delta by def-routef-raw-factor-setting. Therefore ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb <= C_Delta*eta, completing all conclusions for every X in S.B.
